The petitioner filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act 1989, seeking compensation of Rs.7,00,000/- for the injures sustained by him in the road traffic accident occurred on 20.10.2022.
2.

It is the case of the petitioner that, on 20.10.2022 at about 7-45 a.m., within the jurisdiction of Chikkajala Traffic Police Station, near Dussan factory, K.V. Jayaram Road when the Petitioner was riding the unoffending Honda Activa Scooter bearing No.KA-41- EP-5874, at that time, the driver/accused of the offending Car bearing Reg.NoKA-04-MR-1045 drove the same from Hegadenagara towards Jakkur in a high speed, rash or negligent manner so as to endanger human life and dashed the hind portion of the 3 SCCH-7 MVC 6732 / 2022 unoffending vehicle, as a result the Petitioner fell down and sustained grievous injuries on his head, legs and hands.
Immediately after the accident he was shifted to Mahaveer Jain Hospital, Bangalore, wherein he took treatment as an inpatient.
Thereafter, one Vasu lodged complaint before the Chikkajala Police station.

Accordingly, a case was registered in their Crime No.176/2022 and prepared F.I.R. for the offence punishable under sections 279, 338 of IPC and submitted to the jurisdictional judicial magistrate and the superior officers and investigation was taken up by the investigating Officer.
3. Further it is alleged that prior to the alleged accident the Petitioner was hale and healthy and he was aged about 48 years and he was doing Decorator (Manager) job at M.V. Events Co. ltd., and earning an income of Rs.25,000/- p.m.
Due to the injuries sustained in the alleged accident he became permanently disabled and he is unable to do his work normally as he was doing prior to the occurrence of the alleged accident.
The alleged accident is occurred due to fault and negligence act of the driver of the offending Car bearing Reg.NoKA-04-MR-1045.
Respondent No.1 is the Insurer of the offending vehicle and Respondent No.2 is the R.C. Owner of the said offending vehicle
, as such the respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay 4 SCCH-7 MVC 6732 / 2022 compensation to Petitioner.
Hence Petitioner filed the present claim petition for seeking compensation.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act 1989, seeking compensation of Rs.7,00,000/- for the injures sustained by him in the road traffic accident occurred on 20.10.2022.
2.
Accordingly, a case was registered in their Crime No.176/2022 and prepared F.I.R. for the offence punishable under sections 279, 338 of IPC and submitted to the jurisdictional judicial magistrate and the superior officers and investigation was taken up by the investigating Officer.
3. Further it is alleged that prior to the alleged accident the Petitioner was hale and healthy and he was aged about 48 years and he was doing Decorator (Manager) job at M.V. Events Co. ltd., and earning an income of Rs.25,000/- p.m.
Due to the injuries sustained in the alleged accident he became permanently disabled and he is unable to do his work normally as he was doing prior to the occurrence of the alleged accident.
Respondent No.1 is the Insurer of the offending vehicle and Respondent No.2 is the R.C. Owner of the said offending vehicle
The quantum of compensation claimed by the claimants is exorbitant and reserves the right u/s.170 of M.V. Act., and violated terms and conditions of the insurance policy.

from whom?

opennyai_summary.arguments:
It is contended that the alleged accident was occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the driver of the offending vehicle.
The Respondent No.1/Insurance Company admitted the alleged accident and its version is that, the alleged accident occurred due to the negligence and fault of 8 SCCH-7 MVC 6732 / 2022 the injured Petitioner and the said Petitioner negligently drove the unoffending vehicle at the spot with taking note of the approaching the offending vehicle.
There is every possibility of dashing against the offending vehicle without the driver becoming aware of it.
The driver of the offending vehicle cannot save accident, however, slowly he may be driving and therefore he cannot be held to be negligent and therefore the entire negligence ought to have been held against the rider of the unoffending Motor Cycle.
Hence the rider of the unoffending has equally contributed to the accident.
Further it is alleged that the driver of the offending vehicle is not possessing valid DL, FC and effective permit at the time of alleged accident and violated the terms and conditions of the policy.
As such the insurance company is not liable to pay any compensation and in order to obtained compensation the Petitioner has constrained to filed the present claim petition.
Further it is denied that the age, income and occupation of the Petitioner and the petition is false and frivolous in the eye of law and the quantum of compensation claimed by the claimant is exorbitant and sought for dismissal of the petition.
13.
Since the Petitioner has not established his income, he is not entitled for compensation towards such prospects and hence prays dismissal of the petition.
But he has not produced any documents to prove the income of the Petitioner.

26. To prove the percentage of disability sustained by the Petitioner, neither the Petitioner got examined his treated doctor, nor produced disability certificate, hence the Petitioner is not entitled for any compensation under the head future loss of income on account of permanent disability.

It is not in dispute as to the aspect that, the Petitioner sustained grievous injuries in the alleged incident.
Because, for the above reasons collectively, it is clear that, the accident happened due to rash or negligent act of the accused.
It is evident that injuries noted in the Ex.P6/Wound Certificate would be caused by a road accident.
At the same time, it has come out in evidence that the alleged accident was occurred due to rash or negligent driving of the offending vehicle and fault of the accused.
Matters being so, the acts of the accused person clearly constitute the offences punishable under sections 279 and 338 of IPC.

Therefore, the alleged accident occurred due to the fault of the accused/driver of the offending vehicle.
